title: Space bound for the output tape
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, with distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside its image, and let $M$ be an $m$-tape machine. For any initial configuration $c$, background tape contents and head positions, prefix and initial output, and time $t$, the number of distinct positions visited by the head of tape $\mathrm{cap}$ in the silent embedding through time $t$ is at most the length of $M$'s output after $t$ steps minus the length of its initial output, plus one.
